findings.label: Migration wording vs. implementation
findings.detail: Brief asked for an additive migration consistent with the logger's versioning; implementer chose NO schema change (D1) using a `path` marker on the existing `requests` table. This is strictly more backward-compatible and still satisfies `GET /logs?model=glm-5.3:dev&status_code=504`. Documented trade-off in plan.md and verification.md. Acceptable; no action required unless a reviewer insists on a dedicated column.

findings.label: Admin-panel parity not extended
findings.detail: AGENTS.md requires YAML-configurable features to expose admin-UI controls. This feature is always-on with no YAML toggle, so no admin surface is strictly required. A reviewer wanting an on/off toggle would make it a follow-up, not part of this change.

findings.label: Full suite not run end-to-end
findings.detail: Verification ran each touched module individually (error 6, metrics 51, router 253, gateway 90, logger 27) to completion with zero failures plus a clean `cargo check --all-targets`; the single-call timeout prevented one end-to-end `cargo test` log. Evidence is internally consistent and sufficient per the no-rerun instruction. No integration test exercises the full router->handler->logger path end-to-end, but the focused logger test proves the query/distinctness contract against the real query layer.
